buffers and calls [super dealloc]. Prologue 0x00854770 (push {r4-r8,sl,fp,lr}; frame

(0x008547f4-0x00854820, cells 0x00854bc0-0x00854c10) plus the two selector cells

the selector cell 0x00854bbc with self staged at [fp,-0x1c]: blockDirectory (cell
0x00854c10) first at 0x00854870, then the twelve noise functions - heightNoiseFunctionA
(0x00854c0c), heightNoiseFunctionB (0x00854c08), faultNoiseFunction (0x00854c04),
treeDensityNoiseFunction (0x00854c00), rockTypeNoiseFunction (0x00854bfc),

sandNoiseFunction (0x00854bf0), seasonOffsetNoiseFunction (0x00854bec),
caveNoiseFunctionA (0x00854be8), caveNoiseFunctionB (0x00854be4), gemNoiseFunction
(0x00854be0).
C-buffer frees (0x00854a24-0x00854ad8): six __wrap_free calls on the ivar values of
treePositions (0x00854bdc), npcPositions (0x00854bd8), plantPositions (0x00854bd4),
dirtHeights (0x00854bd0), rockHeights (0x00854bcc) and lakeHeights (0x00854bc8) - the
three height arrays and the three position arrays are raw C buffers, not collections.
Tail (0x00854adc-0x00854ba8): [self.lightBlockDatabase release] (cells 0x00854bc4 +
0x00854bbc, dispatch 0x00854b54), [self.lightBlockDatabaseEnvironment release] (cell
0x00854bc0, dispatch 0x00854b78), then the super-call struct {self, class} is built at

(0x00854ba4-0x00854ba8). One unclassified pool cell (0x00854c14) is the PIC base
